description: Upper City: live state of every game in one call (paused flags, counts, today's races and hits, the Ledger clock, weather events running, heat bounties, and `switches`: which extras are ON in this round: vehicle-heist and raid role bonuses, vehicle-heist items, convoy and Ledger weapons). Weather: nine of the 18 event kinds have a game effect, nine are flavour only, and if the weather events count is 0 the engine has never run on this network. Read only.
